title: The General Prologue, Lines 43–78
subtitle: The Knight and the Squire.
objectives: Read and translate authentic Middle English texts.

sections.heading: Content
sections.body: The description of the pilgrims begins. The Knight, the Squire. High style, courtly vocabulary. Vocabulary: worthy (distinguished), chivalrye (chivalry), trouthe (truth, honor), honour (honor), bataille (battle), viage (campaign), Alisaundre (Alexandria), lustier (more vigorous), bacheler (young knight).

items.prompt: What is the focus of this lesson?
Can you apply this to reading?
items.answer: Work through examples with your notes.

lesson_completion.criteria: Mark complete when you understand The General Prologue, Lines 43–78.
